name: siteflow
description: SiteFlow monorepo: web app, mobile app, shared package and Firebase backend

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @siteflow/shared && npm --prefix firebase/functions run typecheck && tsc -p firebase/tests --noEmit
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --project dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --project prod
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:rules && npm run test:web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-siteflow "vitest run --config firebase/tests/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test:web: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-siteflow "npm run test:integration -w @siteflow/web"
